description: Manual complements applied by data/apply_mapping_overlays.py after SOC reconcile. The Schedule of Classes scrape stays the rule; this file is the one place for Qatar campus additions on top of it. Sections run in this order, and a second run changes nothing: (1) overlays: additive requirement mappings only. (2) remove_mappings: removes requirement rows for the listed programs (a list of CS, IS, BA, BS, AI or "all"); runs after (1) so nothing re-adds them, and (1) skips those programs. (3) qatar_visibility: rule show_only_if_offered_qatar sets qatar_only, and the app hides that course unless its SOC offerings include the Qatar campus. qatar_only is owned by this file: a row it no longer lists loses it. Only list what has been confirmed.
